tabs.title: Organize notifications with tabs
tabs.body: Manage the state of your notifications with three tabs: Inbox, Snoozed, and Archive. Each tab shows a count badge.
tabs.step1: Click the tab you want from the three tabs at the top of the page
tabs.step2: "Inbox" shows unread and unhandled notifications, "Snoozed" shows notifications to check later, and "Archive" shows processed notifications
tabs.step3: Simply click a tab to switch the view

filter.title: Filter by priority and type
filter.body: You can filter notifications by priority (Urgent, High, Normal, Low) and type (Notification, Announcement, Mention, Confirmation required, TODO due). Multiple selections are possible.
filter.step1: Click the priority you want in the "Urgency" section (multiple selections allowed)
filter.step2: Click the type you want in the "Type" section (multiple selections allowed)
filter.step3: The filter is applied and only matching notifications are shown
filter.step4: Click the same chip again to clear the filter

snooze.title: Snooze to handle things later
snooze.body: You can temporarily hide notifications you don't need to act on right now. Just pick from the common options (in 3 hours, this evening, tomorrow morning, next week) and you're done.
snooze.step1: Click the clock icon (snooze button) on the right side of a notification item
snooze.step2: Select one of the suggested times (in 3 hours, tonight at 21:00, tomorrow at 9:00, next Monday at 9:00)
snooze.step3: The notification moves to the "Snoozed" tab and automatically returns to your inbox at the specified time
snooze.step4: Click the bell icon on a snoozed notification to cancel the snooze at any time

label.title: Categorize and manage with labels
label.body: You can organize notifications by attaching labels. You can also create your own labels and customize them with colors and icons. Up to 20 labels can be created.
label.step1: Click the gear icon at the top right of the page to open the label management panel
label.step2: Create a new label with "Create label" (set the name, color, and icon)
label.step3: Attach a label you created using the tag icon on the right side of a notification item
label.step4: Click a label filter chip to show only notifications with that label
label.step5: You can attach up to 10 labels to a single notification

bulk.title: Process multiple items at once
bulk.body: Select multiple notifications to snooze, archive, or label them all at once. This is handy when you want to process a large number of notifications efficiently.
bulk.step1: Click the checkbox icon at the top right of the page to enable selection mode
bulk.step2: Click the checkboxes of the notifications you want to process
bulk.step3: Choose an action from the bar shown at the top (archive, snooze, or label)
bulk.step4: Click the "Cancel" button or the checkbox icon to exit selection mode
